audit_items.proof_trace: No audit logging infrastructure exists anywhere in the codebase: grep for 'audit', 'audit_log', 'auditLog' across all TypeScript files returns zero matches, and there are no SQL migration files or Supabase trigger definitions. All three privileged operations — updateMemberAdmin (L423-484), toggleAdminStatus (L492-523), and createGenerationRole (generations.ts L74-102) — return after mutating DB state without writing any persistent audit record. The sole auth gate (checkAdmin) verifies is_admin but emits no event.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A compromised or malicious admin calls toggleAdminStatus to grant an accomplice admin privileges, or updateMemberAdmin to alter a member's generation/status/teams; because no audit log entry is created, the action is undetectable and unattributable during post-incident investigation.
